mapper.select: SELECT * FROM com_authority_candidate WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{candidateId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM com_authority_candidate WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{candidateId} AND deleted = b'0'

choose.when: SELECT id owner_id, 'CONTRACT' owner_type, company_code, master_source_version source_version, authority_status FROM com_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{ownerId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id owner_id, 'SALES_ORDER' owner_type, company_code, source_version, authority_status FROM com_sales_order WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{ownerId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
choose.otherwise: SELECT l.id owner_id, 'ORDER_LINE' owner_type, o.company_code, l.source_version, l.quantity_status authority_status FROM com_sales_order_line l JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.id = l.order_id AND o.deleted = b'0' WHERE l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.id = #{ownerId} AND l.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE com_authority_candidate SET candidate_status = #{candidateStatus}, matched_owner_type = #{matchedOwnerType}, matched_owner_id = #{matchedOwnerId}, matched_owner_source_version = #{matchedOwnerSourceVersion}, decision_reason = #{decisionReason}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, version = version + 1, updater = CAST(#{decidedBy} AS CHAR), update_time = #{decidedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{candidateId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND candidate_status = 'PENDING_RECONCILIATION' AND deleted = b'0'
